description: [Unity] Allowed assembly dependency directions, checked by tools/guardrails/asmdef_rules.py. Assemblies are named <assemblyPrefix><Module>; test assemblies (*.Tests) are skipped. This is a layered example: rename or add modules to match your architecture (user approval).

mustNotBeReferencedBy.UI: Only App and Editor may reference UI. When game logic depends on the screen, headless/server-only runs break. Invert it: UI reads state through a read contract in Core.
mustNotBeReferencedBy.App: App is the composition root; only Editor may reference it. Put the contract you need in Core and let App wire it up.
mustNotBeReferencedBy.Editor: Runtime code may not reference the Editor assembly. The player build breaks.
